submitted_prompt: Create one original-IP Ember Drive transformation concept sheet for Project Veyrshift. Identity reference: plum-haired lean fighter from the base Kairo turnaround; preserve his recognizable face, asymmetrical plum hair, dark cropped jacket, pale shirt, loose dark trousers, split plum cloth, boots and athletic proportions. Comparison reference: existing Ember A with oversized bronze cuffs. Inspiration-only reference: Glass Current B, the slim design with open forearm loops; its identity and provenance must remain Glass Current B. Do not copy or recolor Glass B and do not use crystals, glass, translucent facets, cyan/blue, violet loops, open floating rings or its costume. Design a visibly distinct Ember proposal: heated segmented kinetic armor integrated tightly over one oversized attack-side forearm and shoulder, layered bronze and charcoal plates, mechanical articulation, restrained orange-red core seams and a few ember-hot highlights. Heavy forward-driving silhouette, aggressive anatomically plausible stance. Exactly two full-body views of the SAME design on a single wide transparent sheet: front three-quarter view left, strict right-facing profile right, equal scale and aligned feet, generous transparent gutters. Fully include the head, both arms, hands, legs and feet; consistent rightward head direction in profile; no cropping, detached fragments, text, labels, background, checkerboard, ground shadow, aura, or extra characters. High-quality polished anime action-game concept art, crisp contours and restrained material lighting. This is a review proposal, not a production master.
